catalog_title: iOS and iPadOS Agent Skill Catalog
target_environment: Linux x86_64 inspection host plus a required licensed macOS/Xcode worker

requirement_classes.linux-native: runs completely on the Linux inspection host, offline
requirement_classes.macos-required: needs macOS with Xcode; routed, never emulated
requirement_classes.apple-account-required: needs an authorized Apple Developer account or App Store Connect key
requirement_classes.physical-device-required: needs a physical, personally controlled and trusted iPhone or iPad
requirement_classes.network-required: needs outbound network access to an Apple or third-party service
requirement_classes.license-required: needs a commercially licensed tool (Hopper, IDA, jtool2, PVRTexTool, Charles, Proxyman, MacStadium, device clouds)

implementation_kinds.native: implemented in this Skill Tool and runnable from the CLI
implementation_kinds.plan-only: the Skill Tool emits a validated plan/command set; the Apple-side step is executed elsewhere
implementation_kinds.external: requires the named external tool; this Skill Tool only classifies and probes it
implementation_kinds.reference: knowledge guidance with no code path
